surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process facilitates self-sealing and self-limiting behavior during nanochannel fabrication. The conformal deposition of ALD films allows the nanochannels to be self-sealed, and the diameter is automatically determined during ALD, independent of the film thickness. The self-limiting process is based on the undercut geometry formed during wet etching, which dictates the final nanochannel dimension.
evidence: The text describes the self-sealing and self-limiting behavior of ALD during nanochannel fabrication. It explains that the conformal deposition of ALD films allows the nanochannels to be self-sealed, and the diameter is automatically determined during ALD, independent of the film thickness. The self-limiting process is based on the undercut geometry formed during wet etching, which dictates the final nanochannel dimension. The core/shell structure is formed by sequential deposition of ALD metal and dielectric layers, with the dielectric layer pinching off the top of the nanochannel.
